decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out below:Proposed floor plans and elevations No.3Planning Support Statement Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The premises shall be used only as a children's care home for up to four children and for no other purpose, including any other purpose within Class C2 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order, without the prior written permission of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interests of residential amenity, car parking and highway safety, having regard to Policies DMD8 and DMD45 of the Enfield Development Management Document.

The development hereby permitted shall be occupied by no more than 4 residents and 2 members of staff (excluding ad hoc visiting specialists/ therapists) at any one time.Reason: In the interests of residential amenity, car parking and highway safety, having regard to Policies DMD8 and DMD45 of the Enfield Development Management Document.

Prior to occupation, unless otherwise agreed in writing with the LPA, cycle parking should be provided in compliance with the following criteria:Provision of a minimum of TWO long stay cycle parking spaces in an accessible location: the access route to the store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bike to enter the store, should be step free, close to the entrance and involve no more than 2 doors or gates (excluding the store door) which must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2m; secured: with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob; fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof. Reason: The Council's Climate Action and Transport Policies seek to increase the use of active and sustainable transport modes. This means that access to bicycle parking should be easy and secure to remove potential barriers to cycling.

Prior to first occupation refuse storage facilities including facilities for the recycling of waste to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site, shall be provided within the development, in accordance with the London Borough of Enfield - Waste and Recycling Planning Storage Guidance ENV 08/162 unless otherwise agreed in writing by the LPA.In particular, waste collection vehicles must be able to get within 10m of the refuse storage point. Residents should not have to carry waste further than 30m.Reason: In order to facilitate efficient, safe and clean removal of household refuse, the location and accessibility of refuse storage plus to maintain safety on the Highway.
